levels.description_zh: 突袭者护盾是十字军护盾的改良版，能在装备时使用特有武器 K8 急流火焰喷射器。 此外，突袭者护盾还能根据护盾前方的敌人数量，为使用者和护盾后方所有友军提供伤害增益效果。 护盾技能分阶会随着和核心属性增加。 当护盾被敌人击破时，特工会短时间内陷入混乱状态。
levels.description_en: The striker shield is a modified version of the crusader shield, allowing the K8-JetStream Flamethrower signature weapon to be used while equipped. In addition, the striker shield boosts the damage of the user and all allies behind them based on the number of enemies in front of the shield. Shield Skill Tier increases with both and core attributes. Agents are briefly disoriented when shield breaks from hostile damage.
